## Profile Overview

**Focus areas:** Full stack web development, cybersecurity, data science

## Core Competencies
- **Web / Full stack:** TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js (Fastify), Prisma, Next.js, PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS
- **Systems programming:** C, C++, Linux, Unix
- **DevOps / Infrastructure:** Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Keycloak (identity and access management)
- **Soft skills:** Problem solving, teamwork, training/teaching, event organization, treasury management

## Professional Experience
- **Intern — Yas Madagascar (March–July 2026, 4 months):** Design and deployment of a centralized authentication system based on Keycloak; secured an OSGi Apache Karaf API in a Kubernetes cluster.
- **Trainer — Grandir Dignement Madagascar (Dec 2025–Jan 2026):** Delivered two digital literacy trainings (computers, Internet, AI, prompting, ethics) to about fifteen young people. Social impact project.
- **Communications Manager — Student Council (BDE), 42 Antananarivo (since March 2025):** Internal communication and social media management.
- **Trainer — Parklife (Nov 2024–Jul 2025):** Delivered two computer trainings to 130 employees (introduction to digital tools, then advanced autonomy).
- **Treasurer & Event Organizer — Student Council (BDE), 42 Antananarivo (since March 2024):** Transparent finance management, organization of student events (outings, workshops, conferences).

## Projects
- **Transcendence (TypeScript, Fastify, Prisma, Docker):** Real estate web platform — secure REST APIs with authentication and access control, user management, reservations, credit system.
- **Webserv (C++):** HTTP/1.1 web server written from scratch — protocol parsing, GET/POST/DELETE, non-blocking I/O for simultaneous clients.
- **Inception (Docker, Linux):** Multi-container infrastructure with custom images written from scratch (no Docker Hub images), orchestrated with Docker Compose.
